title: Quote panel UI: new quote, detail, quote dialogs, attachments
objective: Quotes are fully workable inside Lead Detail per PRD 12.7: Quotes card, New Quote modal, expanding quote detail panel with versions/history/attachments, and the six quote workflow dialogs (spec FR-45..FR-50, FR-41).
scope: Quotes card in Lead Detail: columns per FR-44, + New Quote (hidden when lead closed), row expansion, empty state
Quote detail panel: fields, version history, status history, attachments (upload/download/remove), legal workflow buttons
Quote dialogs: Assign/Reassign, Send, Revise, Mark won, Mark lost, Withdraw
implementation_details: features/quotes/QuotesCard.tsx: table columns Quote ref (monospace), Version, Status chip, Quoted premium, Prepared/Sent dates, Valid-until (amber within tenant expiry-alert window, red past), Current marker (radio-like indicator; set-current action permitted per PRD 7.3), row actions menu from quote availableOperations; + New Quote button on card header hidden when lead closed; empty state 'No quotes yet — create one when formal terms are ready.'

NewQuoteModal.tsx: read-only auto ref placeholder ('assigned on save') and version 1; product line/cover type dropdowns defaulted from lead, editable; quoted premium CurrencyInput required; prepared date default today, min lead date received; valid-until optional; notes; primary 'Save as draft' -> toast + new Draft row

QuoteDetailPanel.tsx (expanded row): field grid, VersionHistory list (version, premium, note, created by/at, current badge), status history list, AttachmentsSection (file input restricted to png/jpg/pdf/doc/docx, per-tenant size hint, upload progress, list with download links and remove buttons per closed-quote rules), workflow buttons for current status only

Dialogs reusing WorkflowDialog: QuoteAssignDialog (per configured quote assignable roles); SendQuoteDialog (sent date default today, valid-until required, next follow-up date for the lead required, quoted premium shown read-only for confirmation); ReviseQuoteDialog (new premium and/or terms, revision note); MarkWonDialog (bound premium default quoted, decision date default today, warning 'other open quotes on this lead will be withdrawn'); MarkQuoteLostDialog (reason required, competitor fields, comments; checkbox 'Also close the lead as Lost' default checked when no other open quote); WithdrawQuoteDialog (note, emphasizes lead unchanged)
After any quote op: refetch lead (status may cascade), quotes list, timeline; primary header action on Lead Detail becomes 'Send quote' when a draft exists (completes T-028 PrimaryActionResolver)
quotesApi RTK Query module incl. multipart upload

e2e: quote-workflow.spec.ts: create draft quote from Quotes card (lead pre-Pricing moves to Pricing); send quote requires valid-until and next follow-up, lead chip becomes Quote Sent; revise creates version 2 marked current with history visible; upload PDF attachment and download it, disallowed type rejected inline; mark won defaults bound premium, closes lead Won, sibling quote shows Withdrawn; mark lost on last open quote offers close-lead checkbox; + New Quote hidden on closed lead; expanded panel shows only legal buttons

findings.description: No GET /quotes/{id}/attachments endpoint or QuoteAttachmentDto[] projection exists (T-021 scope), so AttachmentsSection can only display attachments uploaded/removed during the current page session (tracked client-side in QuotesCard's attachmentsByQuoteId map). A fresh page load / lead reload / seeded attachment will not appear in the list. The upload -> download -> remove round-trip works fully within a session, which is what AC-047's server-authoritative rules (type/magic-number/size/audit/round-trip) and V-047's e2e scenario actually exercise; AC-047 text does not require cross-reload UI persistence. A frontend task cannot render a projection the API does not expose (same class as T-028 F-001). Ruled accept-with-backend-follow-up, NOT a blocking T-029 frontend defect; quotes backend is explicitly out_of_scope for T-029.
findings.evidence: src/ui/src/features/quotes/QuotesCard.tsx lines 125-129 (client-side attachmentsByQuoteId state with inline gap comment); src/ui/src/features/quotes/quotesApi.ts lines 223-232 (QuoteAttachmentDto has no list endpoint); src/api/QuoteIQ.Api/Endpoints/AttachmentEndpoints.cs exposes only POST /quotes/{id}/attachments, GET/DELETE /attachments/{id} — no list route.
findings.suggested_fix: Backend follow-up (owning task T-021): add GET /quotes/{id}/attachments returning QuoteAttachmentDto[]; then QuotesCard seeds attachmentsByQuoteId from the quote fetch on expand. Carry to T-042 integration for reload-persistence coverage. UI is already typed forward-compatible.

findings.description: QuoteListItemDto (Quotes-card list projection) carries no version number/count, so the FR-44 'Version' column renders '—' while a row is collapsed and shows the real value only once the row is expanded (GET /quotes/{id}). Forward-compatible; accept-with-backend-follow-up per the T-028 F-001 precedent.
findings.evidence: src/ui/src/features/quotes/quotesApi.ts lines 85-106 (QuoteListItemDto has no versionNo); QuotesCard.tsx line 382 renders currentVersionNo only when isExpanded, else '—'.
findings.suggested_fix: Backend follow-up (owning task T-020): project currentVersionNo (or versionCount) on QuoteListItemDto.

findings.description: QuoteVersionDto projects only createdAt, no CreatedBy, so the version-history 'created by' column renders '—' rather than a fabricated value. Forward-compatible; accept-with-backend-follow-up.
findings.evidence: src/ui/src/features/quotes/quotesApi.ts lines 26-35 (QuoteVersionDto, no createdBy); QuoteDetailPanel.tsx line 120 renders literal '—' for version-created-by.
findings.suggested_fix: Backend follow-up (owning task T-020): add createdBy to quote_versions/QuoteVersionDto.

findings.description: QuoteDto/QuoteHistoryEntryDto project no per-role assignment list and no resolved status/actor names (ids only). Consequently QuoteAssignDialog cannot pre-fill a role's current holder on reassign (every role starts empty) and the status-history actor renders 'User #{id}'. This mirrors T-028's LeadDto gap F-001 exactly. Forward-compatible; accept-with-backend-follow-up.
findings.evidence: src/ui/src/features/quotes/quotesApi.ts lines 37-83 (QuoteHistoryEntryDto/QuoteDetailDto — numeric ids only, no assignment list); QuoteAssignDialog.tsx lines 29-33 doc comment; QuoteDetailPanel.tsx line 141 'User #{id}' fallback.
findings.suggested_fix: Backend follow-up (owning task T-020): project a QuoteAssignmentDto[] (role + current user) and resolved status/actor names on QuoteDto/QuoteHistoryEntryDto.

findings.description: The valid-until amber-within-window / red-past coloring logic (validUntilTone in QuotesCard.tsx) has no unit/component test asserting the data-tone attribute for near-expiry (amber) and past-due (red) cases. The FR-44 coloring behavior is a documented card requirement; it is currently only covered indirectly by the deferred (test.fixme) e2e. Non-blocking (evaluator-side test gap, not a product defect — the logic is correct on inspection).
findings.evidence: src/ui/src/features/quotes/QuotesCard.tsx lines 67-80 (validUntilTone) and line 389 (data-tone render); no assertion on data-tone anywhere under src/ui/src/features/quotes/__tests__.
findings.suggested_fix: Add QuotesCard cases asserting quote-valid-until-cell data-tone='red' for a past validUntil and data-tone='amber' for a validUntil within quoteExpiryAlertDays.
